notes.title: Hoverloop Launches Update Alongside New Open Beta
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/b5f26f4fab7cbbfe3133bbcf4daa225ddcf60dfa.jpg

We're proud to announce an Open Beta weekend for Hoverloop. The open beta weekend will run from 3:00 PM CEST on August 31 to 3:00 PM CEST on September 1st. During this time anyone is free to download and play the game from Steam. Players can pit their drone-piloting skills against each other for clicks and glory for the duration of the beta. 

Players are invited to share their feedback or to report potential bugs during the Open Beta weekend via the Steam Community Hub or Hoverloop's Discord. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/0978c7baf6a469ef339854351be84eaecf3a736c.jpg

As a reward, all the participants will receive exclusive items to customize their drones:

 A Beta Tester Hat
 A Beta Tester Trail
 A Beta Tester Dogtag

Together with the Online Beta, we'll also have a new Update available with the following changes:

 Private Online lobbies for Multiplayer
 Two brand new announcers
 Revamped Mine map
 Tweaks to guns and abilities
 Movement has been tightened both on the ground and in mid-air
 Hitscan replaces projectiles in some weapons
 Improved bot AI
 Updated Tutorial
 Players can now select a custom dog tag in the garage
 Top Player's dog tag is visible on in-game billboards


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/f9ef79619d13ffeeabaef0a17075366f8cd4bd95.jpg

We hope to see you all online next weekend! If you have any questions, shoot! 

For more information, follow @CronosInteractv and @HoverloopNAC on Twitter, 
or visit not-a-company.com.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/1916a52dc9a9421cfff6499e2355d2b7f64fa467.png

notes.title: New Gameplay Trailer!
notes.content:
FLAUNT YOUR FAVORITE GUNS, POWERS AND HATS IN A VIRTUAL DRONE ARENA 
https://youtu.be/7NYK87QNTdQ
The trailer takes a peek at the variety of decorations, guns, and powers available to the player to trick out their personalized vehicle. In addition to the weapons scattered around the map, players can equip a signature ability like the laser wheel or firebreath that are featured prominently. Additionally, a multitude of hats, hover particles, and emotes let the player strut their stuff in the match and the winner’s circle.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/3639a5650347b53a588e53d16ac71e81991be207.jpg

Hoverloop is a multiplayer arena shooter that features customizable hover drones in high-speed combat. Players take their mechanized gladiators into a battle for glory across a multitude of maps and gametypes including modes like Deathmatch and wave-based PvE matches. Both the drones’ abilities and appearance can be personalized to their owner’s preferences. Powerful abilities like death rays, invulnerable shields and teleportation let you pick your playstyle.

notes.title: Hoverloop Gets A MAJOR Update
notes.content:
Time to enter the arena, combatants. Hoverloop is getting some brand new stuff for you to put to the test. Fire up those drones and hover your way to victory!

Get ready to explore the additional features we added to the Early Access build. But first, check out our awesome new trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3oXKhe9msqg
Today’s new update offers a slew of enhancements and new content including a brand-new combat arena set inside an undersea mine and a new Team Deathmatch mode. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/9581933ac338b1e86921a169dac204b30747809a.jpg

The fresh tutorial will help you learn the ropes in your high-speed hover drone while an AI upgrade for computer-controlled opponents will push you to your limits. 

You'll be able to express yourself even more because we added a bundle of new drone skins, hats, trails and emotes to taunt your poor opponents with.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/c68533bafda338de85e8d51ab1c7239602e98fea.jpg

We also made some changes to the UI and added in stuff based on your feedback. Touch up your drone, refine your skills and become the champion of the arena! 

*NOTE: The online mode is still not available as we’re currently working on it. It will be part of the final game at launch in Fall 2019, along with more new modes. Until then, you can invite your friends and family over for some sweet, sweet split-screen action!

"A little louder!"

As always, we rely on your feedback so feel free to give us a shout if you would like to see certain changes or if you have any ideas on how to improve the game. We're all ears!

Here’s the list of the new update content: 

 New level: Mine
 New game mode: Team Deathmatch
 Added Canned chat - Allows the user to send up to 16 different predefined messages.
 Added Oil Trails below the drone when you are damaged as well as particle effect
 New drones and customizations
 Tutorial game mode where you can learn all things Hoverloop
 Polished AI that uses special abilities and random customizations
 AI difficulty levels can now be set via the Host Match UI
 Visual outlines to enhance readability in gameplay
 “Death” UI indicator for teammates in Team Deathmatch that indicates location, as well as time till respawn
 3D Banner showing the best three players inside of the levels
 Pre- and Post-Match lineups - Post-Match showing the winning player’s emotes
 All new custom-made sound effects for UI and Gameplay
 Improved loading screen with generic and gamemode relevant hints and description
 A cheering crowd that reacts to gameplay (audio)
 Cameras that follow the player’s actions (visually, like a sportsmatch)
 Haptic controller feedback for collisions
 Completely revamped level Metropolis

notes.title: Big changes coming to Hoverloop
notes.content:
Hoverloop will become free to play, charging only for cosmetic changes and season pass content.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/684c84a640076d77809557e40aa3f0df34845d33.jpg

Free to play
We have made the decision to adapt Hoverloop from a premium to a free to play game. This decision was made to ensure a larger community and player base at release. Players will be able to make use of our dedicated servers for matchmaking or create their own custom matches on private servers. You will be able to play with or without AI.

We oppose the idea of “pay to win”, so rest assured that we will never sell items that give paying players an advantage in the game. Money spent in the store can only be used on cosmetic items or to unlock season pass content.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28444435/f8b34795e6bac93ef37a88e930a6b765481376db.png

Early Access buyers + Kickstarter backers compensation
Continuing work on Hoverloop would have never been possible without the support of our Kickstarter backers or our Early Access adopters. To thank them, we’d like to offer compensation in the form of a free season pass ($9.99) and a Loops pack (value TBD). (rolling out as soon as these are available)

Demo on Steam Early Access available soon!
A free demo will be made available on the Steam Early Access Page. To start, we’ll focus on an offline mode, including split-screen and AI players but we’ll continue with online tests at a later date. - Feel free to provide feedback along the way.

Customizations
There will be a wide range of customizations available:

 Drones (Common drones + Legendary drones with different unlockable levels/skins)
 Materials for your common drones (Chrome, camouflage, wood,...)
 Hats
 Trails
 Emotes
 Ability skins


How does the season pass work?
After a set period of time, a season pass will come out, ending the previous season. Content from the previous season can no longer be obtained if it wasn’t unlocked.
The new season will reset everyone’s level to 1 with 0 subscribers. (though an all-time count will be kept). Whenever a player gains a level in a season, they’ll unlock cool items (customizations), there will be a free season pass (silver) and a paid one (gold). Having the paid season pass gives you access to way cooler customizations and makes leveling of the pass go faster. At any point in the season, you can buy the current season pass, making you unlock all the levels you have leveled until that point. (both free and paid)

How do you level the season pass?
While playing matches, you can earn viewers through a range of actions:
Scoring kills/double/triple kills
Performing tricks in the air while scoring a kill
Doing an Emote after (leaving you vulnerable for a while)
Having great accuracy. 
In short: by making your play the most entertaining to watch for the viewers. At the end of the match, the viewer count translates into new subscribers. These subscribers count to new level unlocks in your season pass. The more subscribers, the higher your level!


More information following soon!

DISCLAIMER: Everything described above is subject to change.

notes.title: Patch 0.1.1 | 11.06.2018
notes.content:
ONLINE VERSION

CHANGES

- [CHANGED] If you shoot yourself, you now get -1 life instead of +1 life.
- [CHANGED] You start with 2 lives in Last Man Standing instead of 3.
- [CHANGED] Style of the text announcements

ADDITIONS

- [ADDED] Worker bot: it just flies around the levels, minding it's own business.
If you shoot the worker bot, it will explode and drop a random item!
- [ADDED] Drone ring animation. The drones now have a minor animation when you move around.
- [ADDED] You can now see how many lives your opponent has left in Last Man Standing.
- [ADDED] Winning team or player now highlighted on the end-scoreboard.
- [ADDED] Ingame scoreboard now shows more info: for instance how many invasion drones there are left or which wave you are currently in.
- [ADDED] Ability icons in the HUD. (there were missing icons)
- [ADDED] Extra soundtrack.
- [ADDED] You now see visually (text) when a new wave in Invasion starts.

BUG FIXES

- [FIXED] The obstacle gamemode now resets correctly.
- [FIXED] Rocket launcher SFX now changes accordingly with SFX settings.
- [FIXED] Pickup SFX/Invasion drone shoot SFX are now only hearable in their respective surroundings instead of the entire level.
- [FIXED] Special drones no longer have incorrectly positioned guns.
- [FIXED] Deathray glitch is fixed.
- [FIXED] The gametimer now stops after the match is finished, making it impossible to get more points while the endscore screen is showing.
- [FIXED] The client, in a multiplayer game, now spawns directly with the correct drone.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1 | 02.02.2018
notes.content:
ONLINE VERSION (BETA)

The following changes only apply to the Online Version of the game.
This version can be accessed via the Beta tab.
For more information, check the following thread:  [FAQ] Online Version and more

CHANGES

- [CHANGED] Time between each ammo refill in AirHockey got reduced. (3 Seconds -> 1 Second). In addition, we let the weapon reload even if you shoot in the meantime.
This change should still make sure you can't spam shooting, but not limit you too much.

ADDITIONS

- [ADDED] Sound options to the main menu and ingame menu.
You can now adjust Music, Effect, UI and Announcer volume.
- [ADDED] Visual effect on buttons when they are selected.
This should make it eaier for you to see what button you are currently "hovering".

BUG FIXES

- [FIXED] Drone being sometimes invisibile.
This was rather game-breaking, so made sure this shouldn't happen anymore.
- [FIXED] Collision for puck and bullet in both AirHockey levels.
It should now be possible to properly shoot through the gaps.
- [FIXED] Overlap zones that control the automatic doors are no longer blocking bullets by mistake.
- [FIXED] The VR popup at the start of the game shouldn't come up anymore.

OFFLINE VERSION

This following changes only apply to the Offline Version of the game.
This version can be accessed by simply downloading the game, with no beta selected.

CHANGES

- [CHANGED] The rotation in the garage is now facing the camera.
- [CHANGED] Added names to the Dragon and Ninja drones.

ADDITIONS

- [ADDED] Added playernames to splitscreen in garage and in-game.
This should help you to identify yourself easier during battle.

BUG FIXES

- [FIXED] The Obstacle gamemode not properly showing the winner on the endscreen.
- [FIXED] Removed the duplicated playlist in the Tutorial.
- [FIXED] You should no longer respawn at the wrong location in the Tutorial.
- [FIXED] The VR popup at the start of the game shouldn't come up anymore.
